answer: A sybil-resistant design quarantines newcomers on an island market: a fresh identity may only take low-value jobs with other newcomers, and samples of its work are re-checked by auditors. A hollow identity with no audited record gets no access to the main market, however many clones are minted. Passing audits builds a pearl record, a non-transferable score of verified completions. To leave the island for larger payments, the agent must post a bond scaled to job value, slashed for fraud. An attacker must pay audit time, a bond, and a separate record for every clone; an honest agent pays once.
